name: TypeScript ts-morph Context Indexing
purpose: Build and query code-context indexes for TypeScript/JavaScript monorepos with ts-morph: tsconfig-bound loading, compiler-backed type and module graph extraction, reference/implementation search, and incremental file-level refresh.
inputs: Root tsconfig path with project references, module resolution mode, and path alias map
ts-morph 24 and TypeScript 5.6 versions in the Node 20 environment
Token budget caps for query answers (max symbols and max tokens)
Golden symbol set covering overloads, declaration merging, generics, and barrels
outputs: Loaded ts-morph project with source-file inventory and compiler-options report
Queryable symbol, reference, implementation, and import-graph index
Freshness report plus golden recall and latency report
stop_conditions: Golden symbol recall reaches 100% with query p95 under 300 ms on a warm project
Single-file refresh propagates to query results in under 3 seconds
